courses.title: Introduction to Linguistics
courses.description: This course provides a broad introduction to the scientific study of language. Students will explore fundamental concepts in linguistics, including phonetics (the sounds of speech), phonology (the patterns and rules of sounds in languages), morphology (word structure), syntax (sentence structure), semantics (meaning), and pragmatics (language in context). The course will also touch on topics such as language variation, language acquisition, and the relationship between language and society.
courses.advisories: ENGL C1000 or ENGL C1000H or ESL D005.
